render.headline: Need more than a $600 checkout?
render.subheadline: Square Bitcoin Invoices can support eligible invoice totals up to $2,500.

posts.text: Square Bitcoin isn't only a small-ticket checkout story. Eligible U.S. businesses can accept Bitcoin on Square Invoices for totals up to $2,500, including taxes, service charges, and shipping. Bitcoin payment processing is 0% through Dec. 31, 2026, then 1%. Eligibility limits apply; not available in New York, U.S. territories, or sanctioned jurisdictions. Guide: bitcoin4retail.com/square-bitcoin-invoices.html #Bitcoin #Square #SmallBusiness #Payments #Invoices
